wins: Executed full network reconnaissance within first 5 minutes, mapping live hosts and ports with minimal latency (ep001_step04).
Captured service banners and configuration details that highlighted candidate attack vectors before escalating (ep001_step06).
fails: Unable to transfer and execute payloads due to strict outbound filtering and lack of validated upload path (ep001_step08).
Mentor interventions were required 10 times, showing limited autonomy in closing the final exploitation loop.
key_outcomes.summary: Reckoned reconnaissance and enumeration stage performed efficiently, but the run stalled at exploitation due to blocked payload delivery and repeated mentor dependence.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Payload staging attempts fail repeatedly when outbound filtering blocks reverse-shell callback ports, preventing exploitation completion.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a host response includes SSH/MOSH banner on port 22
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap ssh-* scripts to catalog authentication methods and weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80 or 443 returns headers with outdated server version
skill_cards.then_action: Use nikto+httprint enumeration to identify known vulnerable modules for follow-up exploitation

skill_cards.if_condition: When repeated login failures occur but account lockout not triggered
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate controlled credential spray constrained by timing to stay below lockout thresholds

memory_ops.reason: Consistently effective at identifying viable SSH vectors during enumeration.
Generated actionable service vulnerability leads when HTTP headers indicated legacy components.

next_experiments.title: Validate alternate callback channels
next_experiments.description: Test payload deployment via HTTP(S) tunnel to bypass outbound filtering demonstrated in run.

next_experiments.title: Automate credential spray timing
next_experiments.description: Implement momentum-aware scheduling for password sprays that maintain efficacy without triggering lockouts.

next_experiments.title: Integrate staging via writable web directory
next_experiments.description: Probe identified HTTP services for writeable directories and automate payload hosting to avoid outbound restrictions.
